answer: Make each new identity post a slashable bond that unlocks only after peers it never funded attest its work over several epochs. A sybil farm can wrap every account's wording in a fresh cipher, but the bonds still trace back through shared funding paths, so a graph check flags any island of identities rooted in one wallet and slashes the whole cluster at once. Like willow shoots from one stump, the fakes share a root, and each extra one adds another forfeitable bond to the attacker's bill.
